```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"

fun main() {
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<table><tr><td>Product</td><td>Price</td></tr><tr><td>Apple</td><td>1.00</td></tr></table>", ConversionOptions())

}
```
